historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission unanimously refused to abolish the 28-foot setback line along the Quality Inn's Lombard Street frontage, which would have allowed a sign in it (Resolution 8057), and unanimously approved the City's purchase of a strip about four feet wide of that frontage to rechannel the Van Ness Avenue intersection.
A 28-foot setback line was legislated along the corner's Lombard Street frontage, in anticipation of rechannelling the street.
The City Planning Commission approved with conditions, 4-1, nine Sprint Spectrum antennas on the rooftop penthouses of the Comfort Inn building, about 114 feet tall (Motion 14305).
